title: Glyco-functionalization of ECM mimics, influence in morphology and cell behaviour
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00185D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Maddalena Bracchi, Francesco Nicotra, Laura Russo
Glycans are known to regulate cell fate. ECM-mimicking hydrogels conjugated with α-D-glucopyranose and β-D-galactopyranose were developed to study effects on cell morphology and behaviour, showing distinct glycosignatures and protein expression.
